newsitem.title: UK: INSTANT VIEW-UK provisional M4, bank lending.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW-UK provisional M4, bank lending.

text.p: Following is a selection of economists' reactions to UK data showing June provisional M4 rose 11.6 percent year on year, while provisional M4 lending was up 5.5 billion sterling during June. UK building society net mortgage approvals during June rose by 2.206 billion sterling. DAVID PHILPOTTS, SCHRODERS "No great surprises. We were looking for a bit of a rebound from the repo distortion in the May figure, and we seem to have seen that to some extent. The trend is obviously still very firm, and will be of concern to those who regard monetary figures as a leading inflation indicator."

ADAM COLE, JAMES CAPEL "The data was completely market-neutral. While the headline numbers were a little stronger than expected, the underlying picture was bang in line. If you look at the private sector borrowing component excluding the gilt repo effect, it was around 6.0 billion which was bang in line with recent trends."
